name: hr-nexus
description: Human resources management tool. Manages employee records, payroll processing, vacation balances, benefits enrollment and onboarding workflows for new hires. Integrates with corporate directory and time-tracking systems.

tools.name: get_employee_record
tools.description: Returns the employee profile including role, department, manager, hire date and compensation band.

tools.name: check_vacation_balance
tools.description: Returns remaining vacation days, accrual rate and scheduled time off for an employee.

tools.name: start_onboarding
tools.description: Creates an onboarding workflow for a new hire including equipment requests, account provisioning, paperwork and first-week schedule.
